# Project Instructions

## About this project

This is the marketing website for Made by CKT, a UK company creating apps

The primary person working on this website is creative and eager to learn,
but is not an experienced developer.

## Coding Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for all new code.
- Follow the existing code style.
- Explain technical concepts in plain English.
- Keep JavaScript to a minimum.
- When the user is trying to change website content, show them the simplest
  way to make the change themselves where practical.
- Do not modify GitHub Actions, deployment configuration or other infrastructure
  unless the user specifically asks or the change is necessary.
- Do not assume knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Astro, CSS, HTML, Git,
  GitHub or the Terminal.
- Prefer simple, maintainable solutions over clever solutions.
- Ask for clarification if unsure about the user's intent.
